\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize\emph{Notes:} Linear probability models of survival eight years after grant, granted patents of firms and universities filed 2000--2005 (grant lag up to ten years); coefficients in percentage points. Emerging-market offices: China, Korea, Russia, Taiwan and the Czech Republic; advanced-economy offices: the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom and France. Columns 1--2: all owners pooled; columns 3--6: estimated separately for each owner group (--: not applicable). Firm size is inventions filed worldwide in 2000--2005 (small 1--9, mid-sized 10--99, large 100 or more).
